newsitem.title: USA: BT Office boosted by German operations.
newsitem.headline: BT Office boosted by German operations.

text.p: BT Office Products International Inc said its stronger fourth-quarter results benefitted from improvement in its German operations compared to the third quarter.

Acquisitions also contributed to the company's 1996 growth, said president Rudolf Huyzer in a statement. "We added 23 new companies with annualized sales of more than $350 million, which included our entry into Sweden," Huyzer said.
"Although we did not meet all of our expectations for 1996, we are encouraged with our company's progress in the first full year after our IPO in 1995," Huyzer continued.
Earlier, the distributor of office products reported earnings of $0.12 a share on sales of $375.9 million in the fourth quarter and $0.44 a share on sales of $1.41 billion for the full year.
In 1997, BT Office Products said its plan is to focus on integrating its acquisitions and improving operational efficiency.
BT Office Products was up 1/4 at 10-1/8.
